tasks.prompt: Summarise how the Stridewell warehouse cost workstream will bring spend down in Q1 2027, including what it must not cut.

rubric.text: March 2027 spend is to be at least 20% below October 2026, without removing any dashboard viewed in the last 60 days.
The warehouse is not retired in Q1; its contract is renewed and spend is cut inside the warehouse, with the lakehouse move replanned for later.
Tables unqueried for 90 days move to cold storage, except tables that a finance or compliance job reads.
Per-team daily credit limits queue queries over the limit, except that the on-call role is never queued and limits are lifted for the finance role during month-end close.
Any new scheduled query scanning more than 1 TB a run needs a platform team review before going live.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-c
tasks.notes: cross-section: Goals (20% target, dashboards) and Workstream 2 (decision, cuts, credit limits); the superseded warehouse retirement is a trap.

tasks.prompt: Explain how member deletion will work on the Stridewell data platform in Q1 2027 and what it will not cover.

rubric.text: A deletion request must be complete in every store the platform owns within 14 days of the request.
Tables holding only aggregates over 50 or more members are not touched.
Deletions are never undone; support cannot restore a deleted member's workouts.

Whether deletion must reach model training snapshots is undecided; until then snapshots are kept, no new snapshot may include a member whose request is more than 14 days old, and the log records which snapshots a member appears in.
If the account service does not publish the request time, the job uses the time it reads the request.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-c
tasks.notes: cross-section: Goals, Workstream 4 and Dependencies on other teams.

tasks.prompt: Explain what happens to workout events that arrive late or need to be loaded again on the Stridewell streaming pipeline.

rubric.text: Late events are accepted for 7 days after the workout ends; after that they go to the raw archive only and do not reach the curated tables.
Exception: for members who asked support to recover a missing workout, support can replay by hand for up to 90 days.
Replays from the raw archive are run by the person on call and limited to 7 days of data per replay; larger replays are split.
Events from app versions older than 12 months are not handled by the stream processor; they go to the raw archive and are loaded by a small batch job.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-c
tasks.notes: cross-section: Limits, Operating the pipeline and Workstream 3.
